info.name: QA Practice API
info.description: Portfolio API test collection using JSONPlaceholder. Includes response assertions, dynamic variable extraction, CRUD-style demo requests, and negative scenarios. JSONPlaceholder simulates writes; changes are not persisted.

exec: pm.test('Response time is below threshold', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(Number(pm.environment.get('requestTimeoutMs') || 5000)); });
pm.test('Response is a non-empty array', function () { pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });

pm.test('Users have required fields and valid types', function () { body.forEach(function (user) { pm.expect(user.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(user.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(user.email).to.be.a('string'); }); });
const selected = body.find(function (user) { return user.id === Number(pm.environment.get('userId') || 1); });
pm.test('Configured user exists in list', function () { pm.expect(selected).to.exist; });

request.description: Verify a known user and capture its ID.

exec: pm.test('Name and email are populated', function () { pm.expect(body.name).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.email).to.be.a('string').and.include('@'); });
pm.test('Address and company objects are present', function () { pm.expect(body.address).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.company).to.be.an('object'); });

request.description: Negative scenario: request an unknown user ID and assert JSONPlaceholder's observed response contract. Re-baseline this check if the service behavior changes.

exec: pm.test('Missing user response uses expected demo API status', function () { pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

pm.test('Missing user response is empty or a not-found object', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(Object.keys(body).length === 0 || body.error !== undefined || body.message !== undefined).to.eql(true); });

request.description: JSONPlaceholder simulates this create request; it does not persist data.

exec: pm.test('Generated ID is numeric', function () { pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('number'); });

pm.test('Created fields match request', function () { pm.expect(body.title).to.eql('QA API test post'); pm.expect(body.body).to.include('Postman and Newman'); pm.expect(body.userId).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('userId') || 1)); });

request.description: Verify fields returned by a demo update response.

exec: pm.test('Updated body and user ID are valid', function () { pm.expect(body.body).to.include('API regression'); pm.expect(body.userId).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('userId') || 1)); });

request.description: Validates demo delete response only; server state is not persisted.

exec: pm.test('Response body is empty or an empty JSON object', function () { const body = pm.response.text().trim(); if (body.length === 0) { pm.expect(body).to.eql(''); } else { pm.expect(JSON.parse(body)).to.deep.equal({}); } });

request.description: JSONPlaceholder returns an empty object with status 404 for an unknown resource route.

exec: pm.test('Response body is an empty object', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({}); });
